name: weavemap
description: Repo-local project management and real-time DAG observer for AI coding agents and human reviewers.

interface.shortDescription: Project plans, dependencies and a live task HUD
interface.longDescription: Manage repository-local tasks, requirements, dependencies, human approvals and completion evidence with a live editable HUD or a portable HTML snapshot. Requires a file-capable agent environment and Node.js 18 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Use WeaveMap to plan and track this project.
Analyze my WeaveMap tasks for inconsistencies and blockers.
Open the live WeaveMap HUD for this project.
